preferred_rationale: The only capacity figures that exist are the developer's own announcement numbers; no planning or grid documentation corroborates any of them.
notes: Announced as a '1GW site' with initial deployment of up to 6,400 GPUs (a GPU count consistent with only tens of MW of IT load, far below 1 GW — internal inconsistency in the claim). Whether 1 GW refers to IT load or grid import was never specified.
'Future potential to expand to 1.5GW', which would make it 'one of the largest AI infrastructure hubs in Europe'. No supporting planning, land or grid evidence.

claimant: Stop Climate Chaos Scotland (characterising the developer claim)
notes: Campaigners cite the site as requiring 1,000 MW, equivalent to ~25% of Scotland's peak electricity demand. This restates the developer figure; no connection application has been identified.
